subject: if-st-dy
title: IF.ST.DY.------PART.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 493 (MP(II)-11). IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics) is the subject; PART (participation) is the partner. From the subject: INFO-DY (information dynamics), SOC-RT (social reality) and TRS (transition). From INFO-DY: AFI (affinity insight). From SOC-RT: RT-IMP (reality implications). From TRS: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From AFI: ACT (activism). From RT-IMP: CN-INFO (controlled information). From PROG-CONT: TR-INFO (trans-information).
